shots.focal_element: Crew member holding a digital clapperboard in front of the presenter in a dark museum-like set with vintage computers on plinths
shots.what_happens: Behind-the-scenes cold open: a crew member holds a slate up beside the founder in a wide shot while someone calls the take (w0-w1 'Keynote 2.'); the 0.5 s frame already shows a tight close-up of the slate, suggesting the cut lands earlier than the shot boundary.
shots.build_rebuild: Open with a ~0.6 s raw wide set shot of a crew member raising a clapperboard beside the presenter, left ungraded as a deliberate 'behind the scenes' authenticity beat.

shots.focal_element: Digital clapperboard close-up (timecode, 'Keynote', 'Sympatico'), then the founder standing centred in the set
shots.what_happens: Keyframe shows a shallow-focus close-up of the slate with red LED timecode; by 1.0 s the frame is the clean wide of the founder standing centred, hands clasped, ready to speak. The slate's handwriting is prop text, not designed overlay text.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to a 0.5 s shallow-depth-of-field close-up of the slate clapping, then hard-cut to a locked-off symmetrical wide of the presenter centred between lit plinths.

shots.focal_element: Founder standing centred in a symmetrical wide, framed by four corner-anchored title words
shots.typography: Large geometric grotesque sans (low-confidence guess: Inter Display / similar), medium weight, title case for names and caps for CEO, tight tracking; words pinned to the four corners with generous margins
shots.what_happens: As he says 'I'm Zach' (w2-w3) the name pair 'Zach' / 'Lloyd' appears in the top corners; with 'the founder and CEO of Warp' (w4-w9) 'Founder' / 'CEO' appear in the bottom corners, forming a four-corner lower-third replacement.
shots.build_rebuild: Over a centred presenter wide, place four large white sans words in the four corners (top pair on the name word, bottom pair on the title word), each appearing with a quick cut-on with no motion.

shots.focal_element: Founder in a medium close-up talking to camera against a dark tiled wall
shots.typography: Same large white geometric sans, medium weight, title case, split across left and right of the face at eye height
shots.what_happens: Tighter talking head as he says 'Today, I'm excited to demo Warp 2.0' (w10-w17); 'Warp' and '2.0' pop on either side of his head exactly when he says 'Warp 2' (w15-w16).
shots.build_rebuild: Punch in to a shallow-focus medium close-up and cut on the spoken product name as two flanking words ('Warp' left, '2.0' right) at eye level, synced to the word timestamps.

shots.focal_element: Title card 'Warp 2.0 / The Agentic Development Environment' over a painterly grey-blue brushstroke texture
shots.typography: Large white geometric sans, regular/medium weight, title case, tight leading on the three-line tagline, left-aligned with a wide left margin; product name smaller than tagline
shots.what_happens: A rounded-corner card carrying the title slides up from the bottom over the talking head, fills the frame and holds while he says 'the agentic development environment' (w18-w21); a run of chimes (x002-x005) accents the hold.
shots.build_rebuild: Slide a rounded-corner full-frame card up from the bottom over the presenter (ease-out, ~0.5 s), with a grainy painted texture background and left-aligned white title plus three-line tagline, then hold ~3 s.

shots.focal_element: Founder gesturing with both hands in a medium shot, vintage computers soft in the background
shots.what_happens: The title card slides down off-screen revealing a new medium talking-head angle; he says 'Warp 2.0 has four parts.' (w22-w27) while gesturing, setting up the feature list.
shots.build_rebuild: Slide the title card down out of frame to reveal a medium presenter shot with a shallow-focus background, no overlay text.
